data.description: Information pertaining to any cataloging event, generally when and by whom the record was cataloged (often in a written ledger). Method should be used to record the type of catalog recording made (for example, "cataloged in a physical ledger", "cataloged in a digital ledger", or "entered into Specify"). Date should be the date the cataloging event took place and determiner should be the Arctos Agent who performed the cataloging.
The cataloged object's analog information has been converted into a digital format.
The determiner has examined the image and confirmed that the identifier(s) on the image match the record.
The object(s) were included in an inventory by the determining agent on the determination date.
all inscriptions attached to this object have been transcribed.
Media for this record are of poor quality and the object should be re-imaged.
Information pertaining to the manipulation of the cataloged parts as a whole to make them ready for use in education, exhibition or research.
all information recorded in a ledger or catalog attached to this object have been transcribed.
The presence of the object was verified by the determining agent on the determination date.
Data in this catalog record have been checked against ledger, catalog, field notes, or other primary source data. The specific source should be recorded in Remarks.

metadata.description: Curatorial or collections management actions related to a cataloged object. Some actions, especially when related to physical curation, may be more applicable to record as as part attributes.
